question: Harry walked along the beach and collected 34 sea stars, 21 seashells and 29 snails. He lost some of the items and had 59 items left at the end of his walk. How many sea creatures did he lose in all?
A pet shop has a total of 77 animals. 32 of them are kittens and 15 of them hamsters, the rest are birds. How many birds are there?
Debby makes 67 pancakes. She adds blueberries to 20 of them and bananas to 24 of them. The rest are plain. How many plain pancakes are there?
At a carnival, there are 87 kids, teenagers, and adults waiting to get in. 24 are teenagers, 19 are adults, and the rest are kids. How many kids are waiting in line at the carnival?
An international group had 49 Chinese, Americans and Australians. 16 of them were Americans and 11 of them were Australians. How many Chinese were there?
67 medals are displayed in the sports center. There are 19 gold medals and 32 silver medals. How many bronze medals are displayed?
There were 86 pineapples in a store. The owner sold 48 pineapples. 9 of the remaining pineapples were rotten and thrown away. How many fresh pineapples are left?
Lenny has $84. He spent $24 on video games, and $21 at the grocery store. How much does Lenny have left?
There are 96 trees in a park. 15 of them are huge ancient oaks and another 23 of them are medium-sized fir trees. The rest are saplings. How many saplings are in the park?
There were 86 trees in a park. 15 of them died and another 23 of them were cut. How many trees were still left?
A mirror store has 78 mirrors in stock. 8 mirrors are broken, and 57 mirrors are sold. How many mirrors are left?
A restaurant has 67 tomatoes. 32 are made into salads. Another 21 are made into pasta sauce. How many tomatoes are left?
Ryan collected 89 leaves. He lost 24 leaves. After a while, 43 more leaves broke. How many leaves are left in his collection?
There are 4 boys and 5 girls in a preschool daycare. How many children are there in the daycare?
Jack received 8 emails in the morning and 2 emails in the afternoon. How many emails did Jack receive in the day?
There are 5 roses and 5 carnations in a vase. How many flowers are there in the vase in all?
There are 83 trees in a park. 36 of them willows and the rest are oaks. How many more oaks than willows are there in the park?
Ryan collected 89 leaves. He lost 24 leaves and threw away 43 leaves. How many leaves did Ryan have left?

Sam has 58 Power Ranger stickers. He bundles them up in two boxes. If there are 23 Power Ranger stickers in the first box, how many more Power Ranger stickers are there in the second box than the first box?
Antonia has 79 Barbie Dolls. She packs away them in two wardrobes. If there are 35 Barbie Dolls in the first wardrobe, how many more Barbie Dolls are there in the second wardrobe than the first?
Savant has 3 jars. He puts in 34 coins in the first jar, 29 coins in the second jar and 13 coins in the third jar. How many coins does Savant save together?
An online toy store stocked some toys. It sold 38 toys at the first week and 26 toys at the second week. If it had 19 toys left, how many toys were in stock at the beginning?
Mother bought some potatoes. She used 15 of the potatoes to make salads and 24 of the potatoes for mashed potatoes. If there were 13 potatoes left, how many potatoes did mother buy at first?
Joshua has 3 toy boxes for his toy cars. He puts in 21 toy cars in the first toy box, 31 toy cars in the second toy box and 19 toy cars in the third box. How many toy cars does Joshua have together?
There are some rooms in a building. 35 of them are classrooms, 10 of them are office and the remaining 6 are reading rooms. How many rooms are in the building?
